I don't remember off the top of my head, so I need to look it up. I'll search online for Reginald Le Borg's birth date. Let me see... According to a reliable source like IMDb, he was born in 1899. Now, the other film is "Figaro-Ci, Figaro-Là". I'm not as familiar with this one. I need to find out who directed it and when they were born. Let me search for the director of this film. Therefore, Jean de Lettre, the director of "Figaro-Ci, Figaro-Là", is younger than Reginald Le Borg because 1924 is later than 1899. So, the film with the younger director is "Figaro-Ci, Figaro-Là".
</think>
